newsitem.title: INDIA: Philips India falls 9.7 percent at BSE.
newsitem.headline: Philips India falls 9.7 percent at BSE.

text.p: Shares of Philips India shed 8.25 rupees, or 9.7 percent, to 76.75 rupees at the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) on Friday after the firm announced disappointing 1996 results, dealers said.
Philips India on Thursday said its net profit for calendar 1996 fell 65.0 percent to 80.7 million rupees against 229.1 million rupees in the year-ago period.
The company's net sales dropped 2.3 percent to 14.85 billion rupees in 1996 from 15.20 billion in the previous year.
"A slowdown in the economy and depressed market conditions, especially in consumer electronics caused lower sales." Philips India said in a statement.
The company slashed 1996 dividend to 1.0 rupees per share from 2.50 rupees in 1995.
